maria: Heads up — several webinar inbound leads from last night show up as "unassigned" in HubSpot and didn't create SFDC leads. Noticed ~23 leads. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
ashish: saw similar spike at 04:12am UTC. Our HubSpot -> SFDC sync returned 409 on dedupe and aborted assignment step.
eve: SLA reminder: SDR team SLA is 15m to accept/claim. If assignment fails, we need fallback to "sdr-queue-fallback" and email alert.
tim: quick triage: looks like the round-robin webhook timed out during the dedupe error, so the assignment step didn't run. Short-term fix: requeue unassigned leads and force-assignment to fallback queue.
maria: what's the minimal steps to requeue? I can run them if someone gives the command.
ashish: run `hubspot-batch-assign --source=webinar-2026-03-20 --filter=status:unassigned --assign=fallback_sdr`
ashish: Also updating workflow: add post-SFDC-check step: if SFDC response != 200 then set owner=fallback_sdr and tag=needs-review
maria: do we have a playbook for notifying AEs for hot leads? We shouldn't lose P1s.
eve: playbook: tag leads with lead_score>80 as P1, send slack alert to #sales-handoff with link + contact. I'll push a small workflow change.
tim: I'll patch the HubSpot workflow and kick the requeue job. ETA 12 mins. Will post results here.
hubspot-bot: webhook event: 2026-03-20T04:12:33Z -> 409 duplicate detected for email alice@acme.com
maria: thanks — will watch for alerts and sanity-check top 10 P1s once done. If anyone's free to review CSV after requeue ping me.
ashish: follow-up: let's add a monitoring check in console -> routing -> assignment-errors to fire an ops page if error rate > 3% over 10m.
